decision.text: A broadMatch formalizes the passage whether the declaration is a proved theorem, a definition or an equivalence: the asymmetry left over from before decision D1, where a broadMatch to data was partial on a theorem passage and a broadMatch to a definition partial on a definition passage, is dropped (the maintainer's call; the page shows the status beside the best card's relation).

fields.absent: the passage has a checked absence
fields.coverage: null, or the passage's bundle as a record of status rules 2 and 3 carries it (extensions[locate].coverage, cf-locate-recordset/2): complete, parts (location keys of hasPart locations), challenge (a record challenge value), relation (the bundle's: its weakest part's, one of exactMatch, closeMatch, broadMatch), and, as an exported record carries them, conjuncts ([{id, text, part}], c1..cN in order, each beside the part that states it, every part stating at least one) and bundle_key (64 lowercase hex); keys within these six
fields.expected: the derived status, or null for no status (unresolved)
fields.expected_status_rule_2: what status rule 2 derives over the same inputs (tests/data/locate/status-parity-2.json): beside the expectation it shows what status rule 3 changes
fields.locations: the passage's surviving locations after challenge: location_key, relation, proof_status (joined from the library index), statement (the Prop-valued definition flag)
fields.refused: true when the inputs are a contradiction the function refuses
fields.status_rule: 3 on every case: the version of the derivation (status rule 2's cases are tests/data/locate/status-parity-2.json, cf-locate-status-parity/2, and status rule 1's tests/data/locate/status-parity.json, cf-locate-status-parity/1, both unchanged)

function: derive_status(passage_kind, locations, absent, coverage, status_rule=3) -> status | null

reading.text: Status rule 3 is status rule 2 with one change to the rows. On a theorem or conjecture passage a broadMatch formalizes it whether its declaration is proved or data (a definition without the statement flag), as an exactMatch or closeMatch does; on a definition, construction or notation passage a broadMatch to a definition formalizes it, as an exactMatch or closeMatch does. A broadMatch to an unfinished declaration, or to a proved theorem on a definition passage, is what status rule 2 makes it. A survived bundle is still one more location of its weakest part's relation with the fixed stand-in for its proof status, so a finished bundle of broader parts formalizes a definition passage too; everything else is status rule 2.
